title: NYC Street Centerline
authority: NYC Department of City Planning Open Data
limitations: Road centerlines are public route context, not a statement that a road is passable.

title: San Francisco Streets – Active and Retired
authority: City and County of San Francisco Open Data
limitations: Includes active and retired centerlines; operational route status requires city or field confirmation.

title: Hawaii County Roads
authority: County of Hawaii / Hawaii Statewide GIS Program
limitations: Approximate roadway centerlines, not route availability or a field-condition report.

title: Kern County Highways
authority: Kern County Public Works and partner agencies
limitations: Highway context only; it is not a complete municipal street or passability dataset.
